request.query: The Wronskian of linearly independent polynomials over a characteristic zero field is nonzero

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R

items.name: IsCoprime.wronskian_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {a b : Polynomial R},
  IsCoprime a b → (a.wronskian b = 0 ↔ Polynomial.derivative a = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative b = 0)

items.name: Polynomial.wronskianBilin
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing R] → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_add_right
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b c : Polynomial R), a.wronskian (b + c) = a.wronskian b + a.wronskian c

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_eq_of_sum_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {a b c : Polynomial R}, a + b + c = 0 → a.wronskian b = b.wronskian c

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_self_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), a.wronskian a = 0

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_neg_left
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b : Polynomial R), (-a).wronskian b = -a.wronskian b

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_neg_eq
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b : Polynomial R), -a.wronskian b = b.wronskian a
